heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this chapter (other than sections 2324 and 2327 of this title)—

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 2307, Pub. L. 88–210, § 8, as added Pub. L. 105–332, § 1(b), Oct. 31, 1998, 112 Stat. 3083, related to authorization of appropriations, prior to the general amendment of this chapter by Pub. L. 109–270.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–224 amended section generally. Prior to amendment, text read as follows: “There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this chapter (other than sections 2324, 2327, and 2328 of this title, and subchapter II) such sums as may be necessary for each of the fiscal years 2007 through 2012.”

notes.heading: Effective Date of 2018 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 115–224 effective July 1, 2019, see section 4 of Pub. L. 115–224, set out as a note under section 2301 of this title.
